method: Manual read-only inspection; hashes and conclusions only, no upstream copies or executable probes.
conclusions: PopupMenu sizes to screen and available above/below region, enables internal scrolling when too tall.
MenuFloatingWindow clips visible entries and scrolls keyboard selections into view.
FloatingWindow prefers requested direction then alternate directions and clamps screen edges.

Browser fixed DOM popups preserve owned hierarchy and use actual viewport bounds; no native desktop384 fallback, timers/scroller visual equivalence, full floating-window lifecycle or general menu parity claim.
